title: Wyze Sensor Reading Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Zigbee2MQTT device reports (`zigbee2mqtt:device`), Shelly/Tasmota telemetry (`shelly:status`, `tasmota:sensor`), Hue bridge events (`hue:event`), Nest/Ecobee thermostat (`ecobee:thermostat`), door/leak/motion sensors.
app: Philips Hue, smart plugs (Tasmota/Shelly/TP-Link Kasa), thermostats (Nest/Ecobee), locks, and Zigbee/Z-Wave sensors via MQTT / Zigbee2MQTT and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wyze:sensor
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by sensor_type
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>1
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Wyze sensor reading data has stopped arriving for a given sensor type.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per sensor type and alert when the feed is older than 1 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It predicts when one part of your Wyze sensor reading feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
